about: Each weapon's own look and ability effects (Noah, 2026-11-25: 'more variety ... to match what the weapons are actually designed to do so we arent just recycling the same effect with a different color ... based on their weapon description and model' - Both, all at once). Every look keeps Noah's picked family and colour as its ground layer and adds the weapon's own signature; every ability stands on one of Skyrim's own effects (the 'sk' models, from his install) with our own layers over it. Textures 2K; 4K for the wonders and Alduin's Bane.

priest_vahlok.look: Iron chain links wind round the hammer head and its beak, glowing white from within, the links slowly creeping round.

priest_nahkriin.look: The white mist, and a blinding glare that sweeps up the edge every few seconds, like light caught on the steel.

priest_volsung.look: The pale smoke torn back off the edge in long wind streaks, as if the blade were always moving fast.

priest_zahkriisos.look: Frost, with ice crystals standing out of both edges like a glacier's teeth, glinting.

priest_otar.look: The storm, and arcs jumping across the blade from edge to edge, not only along it.

priest_rahgot.look: Green poison fire, and venom beading on the edges and running off the point in drops.

priest_krosis.look: Red mist that weeps: slow streaks running down from the edges, toward the hilt, like tears.

priest_hevnoraak.look: Green molten cracks that run in the lines of a broken seal across the stone, pulsing outward.

priest_vokun.look: Purple core in the blade, and a slow ring of dream-light turning round it, drowsy.

priest_morokei.look: Draining radiance, and a ring of arcane runes turning round the maul's head.

tab_stormtalons.look: Storm on each glass claw, with arcs leaping between the claws.

tab_gravebell.look: White molten cracks, and rings of sound rolling off the bell head on a slow beat.

tab_talons.look: Red fire on each dragonbone claw, blood running off the points.

tab_riverstone.look: Green core in the blade, the steel crusted with river stone and moss-light in its cracks.

tab_wyrmspine.look: Red-black fire pouring forward off the pike's point like a dragon's breath.

tab_lanternwick.look: Ice-blue core on both heads, snow whirling round each head.

tab_cinderclaws.look: Orange core in each claw, embers streaming off the points as it moves.

tab_eclipse.look: Moon fire on the spearhead, a dark ring crossing a bright one at its heart.

tab_frostmourn.look: Ice-blue mist with cold breath sinking off the blade, rime creeping up from the guard.

tab_silverscythe.look: Moon-silver core, and a bright glint sweeping along the blade's edge.

tab_bonereaper.look: Green core, and souls streaming up off the blade in thin ghostly trails.

tab_wyrmtooth.look: Green core, the dragon teeth along the blade lit at their tips.

tab_bloodmoon.look: Red core, with blood running down the blade and off its point.

fang.look: Orange mist with Alduin's fire under it: embers rising and dark smoke curling through. 4K.

alch.look: Shadowflame: violet-black fire with dark embers lifting off it.

carian.look: Purple mist over the whole wand, with glintstone sparkles turning in it.

radiant.look: Gold core on both heads, short rays of sunlight standing off them.

ss_none.look: White core, bare: the rapier with no spell in the other hand.

ss_fire.look: Fire running up the rapier, sparks lifting off the point.

ss_frost.look: Frost along the rapier, fine ice needles on its edge.

ss_shock.look: Ice-blue storm, sparks jumping off the point.

ss_sun.look: Orange radiance, sun rays standing off the blade.

ss_blood.look: Blue spirit wisps streaming off the rapier.

slayer.look: Gold mist, the Dragon Slayer's runes burning brighter under it. 4K.
